# Print sheet, final design F2 (generated by kit.py)

Status: **planned**. Nothing is printed. Mass and time are estimates from the CAD volume, not from a slicer.

**Assumed:** PETG at 1.27 g/cm3, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, 4 perimeters (1.6 mm), 5 top and bottom layers, gyroid infill. The time model is 5 mm3/s of plastic, plus 20 % for moves, plus 10 min per part. Your slicer gives the real time.

The STL files are in the robot frame. Turn each part to the orientation in the table in the slicer.

Print the 4 tank pieces solid (100 %), so that the walls hold water. Glue each plate on its tub with two-part epoxy. Leak-test each glued tank for 1 hour.
